metadata.title: Flexible discrete translational surfaces
metadata.abstract: We give a full list of translational nets which flex within their class of discrete surfaces of translation, by reducing the classification problem to the one of flexible complete bipartite frameworks on the sphere, for which the solution is known. We also obtained two novel classes which correspond to Bottema's spherical 16-bar mechanisms and the constant diagonal angle frameworks. Based on an algorithm for the construction of all flexible translational nets, we also discuss flexible translational tubes and toroids. Furthermore, we present novel results for both topologies which are implied by Bottema's spherical 16-bar mechanisms.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 柔性离散平移曲面的分类
analysis.workSummary: 将平移网在同类内的柔性分类化约为球面完全二部框架，给出完整列表和构造算法，并讨论平移管与环形曲面，包含由 Bottema 十六杆机构产生的新类型。
analysis.breakthrough: 用已知框架分类组织全部同类柔性平移网。
analysis.limitations: 柔性保持在平移曲面类别内，不能等同于任意离散曲面的柔性分类。
analysis.priorityReason: 用已知框架分类组织全部同类柔性平移网。
